articles.summary: Steve Fritze to retire at April Annual Meeting of Shareholders Otter Tail Corporation has appointed Mr. Chris Clark of Minnetonka, Minnesota, and Mr. Steve Rasche of St. Louis, Missouri, to the company’s Board of Directors, effective January 1, 2026. Mr. Steve Fritze Outgoing Board Member Steve Fritze, who has served as an independent Board member since 2013, will serve his last day at the Company’s upcoming Annual Meeting of Shareholders in April 2026. articles.title: Otter Tail Corporation Appoints Chris Clark and Steve Rasche to Board of Directors
